editVaultGamerule.title: Vault Hunters Game Rules
gamerule.finalVaultAllowParty.descriptio: Controls whether players can form a party in the Final Vault
gamerule.questExpertMode.description: Enables more challenging quest requirements and conditions for experienced players
gamerule.vaultAllowKnowledgeBrew.descrip: When enabled, Knowledge Brews can be used. Research of the player who crafted it is granted to the user that drinks it
gamerule.vaultAllowMentoring.description: When enabled, Mentor Brews can be used. When a level 100 user makes a brew and gives it to their level 0 friend, that friend will become level 100
gamerule.vaultAllowWaypoints.description: When enabled, users can set waypoints in vaults
gamerule.vaultBoostPenalty.description: When enabled, players running lower level vaults will not gain experience
gamerule.vaultCrystalMode.description: Controls vault crystal crafting cost. Infinity makes crystals free
gamerule.vaultCrystalRecipeScaling.descr: Determines how quickly the crystal recipe scales. Slow: 0.5x, Normal: 1.0x, Fast: 2.0x, Extreme: 5.0x
gamerule.vaultHeraldMinLevel.description: Sets the minimum level required to face the Herald and enter the Final Vault
gamerule.vaultJoinRequireParty.descripti: When enabled, players can only join vaults of those they share a party with
gamerule.vaultLevelLock.description: Maximum vault level any user can reach
gamerule.vaultLevelSyncEnabled.descripti: When enabled, players can form level sync teams to share a single vault level and exp pool
gamerule.vaultLevelSyncPenalty.descripti: Extra experience required to the next level per additional team member. 50% means 2 players need 1.5x exp, 3 players need 2x exp
gamerule.vaultLocker.description: When enabled, users can retrieve their spirit by going into debt
gamerule.vaultPreloadTemplates.descripti: When enabled, all vault templates will be pre-loaded when the world or server is loaded. This uses more RAM, but gets rid of the lag spike upon entering the first vault since restart
gamerule.vaultDollAI.description: When enabled, Vault Dolls will have an AI, causing them to actively run away and avoid players. When disabled, the dolls become immune to damage
gamerule.vaultMode.description: How items are restored after a death. Normal: items kept in spirit. Casual: all items kept, no progress lost. Hardcore: all items voided, no spirit.
gamerule.vaultNoOpDifficulty.description: Allows non-operator players to change vault difficulty settings
gamerule.vaultNoResearchTeamPenalty.desc: When enabled, research cost is not increased for having team members. When disabled, research cost increases by 50% per team member
gamerule.vaultPartyExpSharing.descriptio: Controls how experience is shared among party members in vaults
gamerule.vaultPartyMapSharing.descriptio: When enabled, rooms discovered by party members will show up on your vault map too
gamerule.vaultPrintSaveDataTiming.descri: Prints timing information when saving vault data. Useful for debugging performance issues
gamerule.vaultSpectatePartyOnly.descript: When enabled, users can only spectate party members
gamerule.vaultSpectatorMode.description: Controls how players can spectate ongoing vaults. Off: disabled, Player: spectate specific players, Freeroam: free roaming
gamerule.vaultTemplateCacheSize.descript: Maximum number of vault templates to keep in cache. Higher values use more memory but improve performance
gamerule.vaultTimer.description: Amount of time all users receive in their vaults. Setting this to 0 will give everyone infinite time
gamerule.vaultWeightedArtifacts.descript: When enabled, artifacts have weighted drop chances based on rarity. When disabled, all artifacts have equal probability
